plugins.name: delva-os
plugins.description: The core. Build a personal AI operating system in one sitting: a CLAUDE.md router plus a real knowledge directory, a voice file built from your own words, and an audit skill to keep it from going stale. Everyone starts here.

plugins.name: proposal-from-transcript
plugins.description: Turn a sales call transcript into a finished, branded HTML proposal with scope and pricing.

plugins.name: build-prototype
plugins.description: Turn a client call or requirements doc into a live clickable prototype — landing page, working sign-in, seeded demo data — deployed through the Lovable MCP, returning a URL the client can open.

plugins.name: meta-campaign-builder
plugins.description: Turn a folder of creatives into a complete, paused Meta ad campaign: account preflight, every setting asked up front, media uploaded, campaign/ad set/creatives/ads created. Bundles the Meta Ads MCP.

plugins.name: ad-angles-from-calls
plugins.description: Mine recorded calls for the pain points buyers state in their own words, rank them by frequency x severity, and turn the top ones into static and video ad concepts with copy. Portable: run it on your own calls or on a client's.
